data.description: This is Nufacks undead body then he evolves into monster # 27
data.name: Nufack

data.description: These strange creatures came from magic sludge in deep caverns.  Not much else is known about them.
data.name: Clothop

data.name: Warrior Thief

data.name: Bone Crab

data.name: Leopard Crab

data.description: These huge mounds of evil sludge exude electrical power that stuns unwary victoms so they can be digested.
data.name: Black Sludge

data.description: These magical creatures escaped from a wizards lab and multiplied.

data.name: Srake

data.description: Born of pure evil.  These beautiful, deadly creatures love to inhabit murkey forests.
data.name: Emerald Dragon

data.description: Ions ago a race of trolls became infected with a terrible disease.  Though they have since become immune to disease, the descendents live in pain.

data.description: Humanoid in shape but actually made from a colony of semi-intelligent mosses.
data.name: Mushoid

data.description: A real monster.  Fortunatly, this eight legged monstrosity has NO venom.
data.name: Giant Widow

data.description: A real monster.  A paralyzing venom could well be the least of your worries when you encounter these huge spiders.
data.name: Death Widow

data.description: Be careful not to fall victim to a bite from one of these.  Their bite has been known to cause paralysis.
data.name: Trench Spider

data.name: Dark Ogre

data.name: Stygian Troll

data.name: Ghoul
